parameters.formDescription:
Starts a Claude Code session in the cluster. Open claude.ai/code about a minute after submitting and pick the new session. One session at a time; it is removed when the session ends (or after 8 h).

standard: read-only kubectl, no Secrets.
privileged: can change workloads and exec in halo, edit alerts/dashboards in monitoring. Never Longhorn, ArgoCD, ESO or RBAC.

Both modes push branches and open PRs, never to main.

parameters.completionMessage: ={{ 'Job ' + $json.metadata.name + ' created (' + $('Decide').first().json.mode + ', ' + $('Decide').first().json.repo + '). Open claude.ai/code in about a minute.' }}
The session pod is being removed. Unpushed work in it is gone.
